_description: Unified tax: income surplus covers spending. No portfolio withdrawal needed. Tests the no-withdrawal path.
_rationale: Single filer, Florida, pension $50k (before_tax) at age 60 + $2k/mo spending ($24k/yr). 0% growth/inflation/stddev. Income exceeds spending. Tax on $50k: deduction $16,100, taxable $33,900. Fed tax = $1,240 (10% on $12,400) + $2,580 (12% on $21,500) = $3,820. Net income = $46,180. Net cash flow = 46180 - 24000 = $22,180 surplus/yr.
name: Unified Tax: Income Covers Spending
